Placeholder, tracked in [#57](https://github.com/UBC-DSCI/reproducible-and-trustworthy-workflows-for-data-science/issues/57).

These topics were taught in the Poetry continuous deployment chapter,
now in the Archive as [Continuous deployment: Python (Poetry)](9550-continuous-deployment-python-poetry.qmd).
They do not depend on Poetry, so they come back here:

- storing credentials with GitHub Secrets, and the `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- setting `permissions:` in a workflow file
- semantic versioning, with the Python version case study
- conventional commit messages
- publishing levels: GitHub, TestPyPI, PyPI
